messages.subject: colext model fitting
parts:
Hello,

I am doing some model fitting with colext and I want to first test for the best model for the 'pformula' before testing the 'psiformula', gamma, and epsilon.

Does anyone know of a way to extract the 'p' from the best model of a fitlist in a way that will allow it to be pasted into a new colext model? 


I use this code to clip the best model for 'p':

c<-as.formula(ms@Full$formula[ms@Full$delta<2])
cc <- stri_sub(c, from=12)


I've tried this to create the new colext model: 

kk <- paste0("(~1,~1,~1,",cc,",umf)"))
m1 <- colext(kk)

I get this error:
Error in data@y[data@y > K] <- K : 
  argument "data" is missing, with no default

Thank you for your imput
Kyle

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] colext model fitting
parts:
Hi Kyle,

Its not the most sophisticated code, but if you really only want the top model from ms you can do this:

c<-as.character(ms@Full$formula[1])
cc <- strsplit(c,"~ ")

m1 <- colext(~ 1, ~ 1, ~ 1,as.formula(paste("~",cc[[1]][4])), umf)

You can use the cc route further on as well as elements 1-4 represent the parts of the formula (psi, gamma, eps, p).

Cheers,
Richard S

models@fits[ms@Full$delta=='0']

The output class is unmarkedFitColExt and I can't figure how to coerce it into a data.frame.

I ran showMethods(coerce) and noticed that this class isn't listed. 

Thank you
Kyle
